# Tech A-Nap

> Tech A-Nap is a software development studio in Thailand. We build websites, mobile apps, and custom software/ERP systems for startups, growing businesses, and enterprises — from first MVP to enterprise-grade systems. The team communicates fluently in Thai and English.

## Services
- Web Development — corporate websites and web applications
- Mobile App — iOS and Android apps
- Custom Software & ERP — purpose-built systems and back-office tools
- MVP Development — turning an idea into a testable product quickly

## Process
Discovery → Design → Build → Launch → Support
